title: Stream RTMPS Url
description: Payload of the stream:rtmps_url envelope. Carries the IVS Real-Time RTMPS ingest endpoint and the publish participant token the REAPER extension needs to configure ReaCast, plus the token expiry so the extension can show the producer when a fresh one arrives.

stageArn.description: ARN of the IVS Real-Time stage the extension publishes into.

rtmpsIngestUrl.description: RTMPS ingest endpoint from the CreateStage response, entered into ReaCast's destination field by the producer.

streamKey.description: Publish participant token, used as the ReaCast stream key. Treated as a credential: never logged.

participantId.description: Identifier IVS assigned to the publishing participant, safe to log and to correlate with stage events.

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the publish token expires at.

reissued.description: True when this token replaces an earlier one — a reconnect or a proactive renewal rather than a first issue.
